distinction: Mathematical countermodels test an inference in a stated scope. Semantic controls only show that one API substitution is rejected by the type checker; they are not counterexamples to every theorem connecting the objects.
mandatory_use: Every candidate supplier in EXPERIMENTS.json must state which models it survives before formalization begins.
sharding: Controls run in two shards (84 pinned pre-frontier, 41 frontier) under the fixed worker source name; each control must own exactly one type-mismatch error.
